answer: To resist Sybils, networks enforce game-theoretic multi-agent auditing structured along a trust trellis graph. Peer nodes verify topological cut bottlenecks; if an identity cluster bottlenecks through an artificial bridge ledge, cross-auditors trigger stake slashing. Sybil duplication induces an escalating spiral of bonded stake, imposing a superlinear attacker cost O(N^2) that renders large-scale identity spoofing mathematically irrational.
